item.title: Handling Postgres Locks and Connection Starvation in Go (Part 2)
item.description: In Part 1 of this series, we explored how PostgreSQL manages backend processes and OS-level locking. Now, we will look at how those database-level locks interact with an application’s connection pool, causing connection starvation, and how to elegantly mitigate these issues in Go using GORM.
